channel.title: The Dive Bell
channel.description: Rings, take-backs, the week ahead and the record, from a bell that texts divers only when the water is perfect.

item.title: The bell is ringing
item.description: THE BELL IS RINGING - LAGUNA BEACH. Tue Aug 11 at dusk: flat, glassy, dry, sunny, 68F water. In by 5:41pm at Shaw's Cove. thedivebell.com/laguna-beach/

item.title: The record
item.description: Laguna Beach rang for Tue dusk and the ocean kept the appointment: buoy 1.1 ft @ 14.0 s, wind 3.0 kn, dry, cloud 10%. The record: 2 rings, 1 held, 1 broke. thedivebell.com/record/
